title: Uruguayan Spring Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with spring lamb, potatoes, and onions, inspired by the traditional Uruguayan cuisine.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh herbs (such as parsley, thyme, and rosemary)

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, chopped herbs, and nourishing broth to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
